standard_prerequisites.name: Surjectivity on relative cotangent spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that a surjective map of Artinian algebras induces a surjection on the relative cotangent spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the surjectivity of the transition maps on the cotangent spaces, hence the stabilization of their dimension.

standard_prerequisites.name: The adic topology of a quotient of a complete Noetherian algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma describing the quotient of a complete local algebra by the intersection of a compatible system of ideals as the limit of the quotients, with the induced topology
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the identification R/J = lim A_n and the statement about the topology.

core_obligations: Stabilize the cotangent space (proof lines 1287-1296): the transition maps induce surjections on the relative cotangent spaces, so their dimensions eventually stabilize to some r; choose elements x_1, ..., x_r in the limit whose images generate the maximal ideals of the A_n, and elements y_1, ..., y_t whose images generate k over Lambda, giving a surjection from a polynomial ring P onto every A_n compatibly.

Build a complete algebra mapping to the system (proof lines 1296-1305): let m be the kernel of P -> k and R the m-adic completion of P, which is an object of the completed category; the compatible surjections give a map R -> S = lim A_n, and setting J_n equal to the kernel of R -> A_n and J to their intersection.

Identify the limit and the topology (proof lines 1305-1310): the topology lemma applied to the system of ideals J_n gives R/J = lim R/J_n = lim A_n = S and shows that the ideals J_n/J = I_n define the m-adic topology; a renumbering of the ideals may be needed because m_R^{N_n} is contained in J_n for some N_n which need not equal n.
proof_roadmap: Use the stabilization of the cotangent space dimensions to produce a polynomial presentation compatible with the system.
Complete the polynomial ring and map the completion onto the system of quotients.
Apply the topology lemma to the kernels of that map to identify the limit and its adic topology.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a sequence of surjective maps of Artinian algebras whose relative cotangent dimensions are bounded has a limit in the completed category, and that the kernels of the projections define its adic topology (statement lines 1277-1285). The proof (proof lines 1287-1313) stabilizes the cotangent dimensions to build a compatible polynomial presentation, completes the polynomial ring and applies the topology lemma to identify the limit and its topology. H2: a three-step construction with two inputs, written out in full.
